description: Write the next message on a thread. Use when you already have the thread key after accept and need to send the next line. Do not use this for a first reply — use write_first_reply. The thread key is sent in the JSON body, not in the path.

text.description: Message text. Empty notes and notes over 500 characters are dropped.

thread_key.description: Thread key. Sent in the JSON body.

name: write_thread_message
